description: This file contains tests for the tenantClient utility functions, verifying behaviors such as tenant ID normalization, fetching session tenants, selecting tenants, and managing active tenant state.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID representations to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants associated with the current session.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects and activates a tenant, updating local storage and making a server call.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in local storage, replacing any legacy keys.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID.
